items.title: Fan Art Competition Winners
items.excerpt: Our Fan Art Competition concluded last week, with more than 150 Exiles submitting artwork inspired by the latest Path of Exile and Path of Exile 2 content expansions. With the help of our art team, we’ve selected the winners and are now ready to announce them! Because of the enormous number of amazing submissions, it was really hard to select just three overall winners. So, we decided to award the top five winners in both games, as well as introduce a separate category for the top physical art submissions. Click here to check out the winners! items.title: Path of Exile 2 Full Release Registration
items.excerpt: Sign up at https://pathofexile2.com/register to receive updates on the Path of Exile 2 Full Release and get exclusive rewards! You have until December 10th to register, so there is still plenty of time to reach the milestones. The more players who register, the more cosmetics the community can unlock. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770983/b83d97b61de11f586aeb96da8868910194192cd6.jpg Please note that you need to confirm your registration after entering your email address. If you submitted your email address earlier, please check your inbox for a confirmation email from us!

items.title: Path of Exile 2: Forbidden Rites FAQ
items.excerpt: Last week, we announced Forbidden Rites, an event league in Path of Exile 2 launching alongside the 0.5.5 patch on September 4th PDT. In this news post, we’ve answered some of the most common questions from our community about the event. Is Duelist in 0.5.5? No, Duelist will be released on December 11th when Path of Exile 2 1.0 fully launches. Is this a new league? Yes. As all new leagues, Forbidden Rites comes with a fresh economy and a whole set of new challenges with exclusive rewards. What time does Forbidden Rites begin?
